approval.confirmation_reference: The user explicitly authorized uninterrupted best-in-plan execution and requested automatic optimal choices without repeated approval.
approval.scope: One immutable zero-training C07 evaluation corrective over the three sealed composition-anchor checkpoints; no C08+, graph or M-TARE.

corrective_scope: The source completed all 30699 optimizer steps and three checkpoint selections. Its evaluator then rejected a finite mathematical score because left-associated float32 multiplication differed from its transpose by one ULP. This run groups endpoint evidence as an exactly symmetric outer product, performs zero optimizer steps, and repeats only the frozen C07 evaluation.

estimated_cost.compute: One RTX 5090 D; one frozen pass over 64644 C07 rows for each of three seeds.

failure_policy: Any source-seal, checkpoint, input, environment, population, symmetry, resource or isolation drift fails closed. A valid model scientific FAIL is retained as a valid corrective execution outcome and stops before C08/graph; no retraining or threshold change.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.decision: A valid PASS opens only a separately frozen C08 transfer/readiness step; a valid scientific FAIL stops before C08/graph and triggers C07-only attribution.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.isolation: Optimizer steps, C08 rows, C09/C10 worlds, graph replays and M-TARE reads are all zero.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.numerics: All corrected safe scores are finite and bit-exact symmetric on every C07 batch; the legacy left-associated asymmetry is reproduced and quantified.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.population: Each of seeds 0/1/2 reads exactly 64644 C07 rows and the evaluator verifies 442936 observable positives.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.resources: Wall time <=4 h; host RSS <=4 GiB; GPU process memory <=16 GiB; output <=0.5 GiB.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.science: Use the unchanged gates: attachment F1 gain >=0.05, precision>=0.98 with TP>0, anchor MAE improvement>=10%, frozen backbone, and at least 2/3 passing seeds.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.source: The sealed source has exactly 30699 optimizer steps, three valid selected checkpoints and only the known post-training evaluator failure.

purpose: Recover the missing C07 scientific decision from three already trained and sealed composition-anchor checkpoints after correcting only float32 multiplication grouping.
retention: Retain source failure provenance, corrected per-seed C07 metrics, numerical symmetry evidence, comparison PNG/PDF/SVG, logs, resource monitor, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

sampling.independent_sampling_units: 10 disjoint C07 topology parents and 30 paired geometry tasks; each frozen seed is an independent trained model evaluated on the same sealed rows.
sampling.rule: Read every C07 sequence exactly once per frozen seed at batch128 with the original existence thresholds; no shuffle, adaptation, optimizer update or checkpoint selection.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of project-generated Cano assets; redistribution remains subject to upstream licensing.
raw_sources: sealed P1a corrected C01--C07 sensor pose and construction-program primitive endpoints
sealed P1b C01--C07 five-frame cropped primitive axes and endpoint-neighbor labels
sealed V2 relation failure attribution establishing zero safe true attachment for all three seeds

split.development_transfer: C08 remains unopened even if C07 passes; transfer requires a separate frozen run.
split.fit: All C01-C06 parents and all three paired geometry realizations provide gradients.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Earlier C07 relation failures motivated the pre-registered composition-anchor target only. No C07 result from this run may trigger architecture, Teacher or threshold changes in-place.
split.selection: All C07 parents select one checkpoint per seed by mean anchor total loss; the final exact ranked C07 threshold is a validation metric and cannot alter data, model, loss, epochs or gates.
split.strict_test: C08/C09/C10 and all M-TARE benchmark worlds remain unread.

teacher.labels: Per-endpoint shared 3-D anchor, relation target, disconnected-overlap hard negative and endpoint support.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: A future graph may use high-confidence connection proposals, but only physical traversal can commit an edge.
teacher.source: Sealed construction-program composition anchors in current-sensor coordinates, exact P1b primitive slots and the sealed dual-endpoint observability validity sidecar.
teacher.student_forbidden_inputs: Construction/world/node/primitive identity, absolute pose, TNG, future frames, support bits at forward, C08+ and planner state never enter the student model.
teacher.valid_mask: Only matched active endpoints with current-window support enter anchor regression; physical relation metrics use dual-endpoint-observed pairs and hidden pairs remain unknown.
